title: Operation Crownfall
premise: A British royal is kidnapped by a violent terrorist organization during a high-profile public appearance. As international tensions rise and a media frenzy engulfs the nation, MI5 launches a multinational manhunt to locate the hostage, dismantle the terrorist network, and prevent a political catastrophe before time runs out.
logline: After a British royal is abducted by terrorists, an MI5 task force races across a web of clues, betrayals, and hidden safehouses to bring her home alive.

visualTone.lightingPhilosophy: Gritty espionage realism driven by practical light sources, emergency strobes, urban sodium vapor spill, and deep contrast silhouettes

sets.name: Royal Charity Square

sets.lighting: Overcast daylight with flashing camera strobes and emergency vehicle lights.

sets.lighting: Storm-filtered sunset mixed with helicopter searchlights.
